title: One message per incident, and one when it clears
description:
**Milestone:** M1, first slice

**Goal.** As an operator, I get one message when an alarm starts and one when it ends, however often it flaps, because too many notifications is the same as none.

**Build.**
- `src/caducus/notify/incidents.py`; row `INCIDENT#<aws account>#<region>#<alarm>` / `STATE`.
- ALARM opens an incident and notifies once. A further ALARM on an open incident counts and does not notify. OK starts a hold-down; if it stays OK through the hold-down, one clearing message with the duration and the number of flaps. INSUFFICIENT_DATA is logged and sends nothing.
- Honour `detail.muteDetail`: a muted alarm records but does not notify. Hold-down is one setting in the catalog, read per alarm; adjust it from observed flapping, not by a cap.

**Acceptance.**
Table-tested state machine; behave features.

**Depends on:** kanbus-ad0a0d, kanbus-be0e9d

**Specification.**
```gherkin
Feature: Incidents
  Scenario: A flapping alarm is one incident
    Given an alarm entered ALARM and a message went out
    When it goes OK and back to ALARM within the hold-down, three times
    Then no further message goes out

  Scenario: Clearing sends one message
    Given an open incident
    When the alarm stays OK through the hold-down
    Then one message says it cleared, how long it lasted and how many times it flapped

  Scenario: Missing data is not an incident
    When an alarm enters INSUFFICIENT_DATA
    Then no message goes out and the transition is logged
```
